CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Mobile__c), LEN(Mobile__c) < 8), "+85200000000", IF( LEFT(Mobile__c, 1) == "+", Mobile__c, IF( ( LEFT(Mobile__c, 3) == MID(TEXT(Country_Code__c),FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) + 1,FIND(")", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - 1)), ("+" + Mobile__c), TRIM("+"+MID(TEXT(Country_Code__c),FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) + 1,FIND(")", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - 1) + SUBSTITUTE(Mobile__c," ",""))) ) )
CustomField.label: Mobile (S) - Exclusion
